summary_1line: Narada learns the mythic origin of the Pitris and pindas from Vishnu’s Varaha act, affirming that honoring ancestors and beings is ultimately worship of Narayana.

image_candidates.scene_text: Vishnu as the colossal boar Varaha lifts the Earth from the waters, three balls of mud dropping from his tusk onto kusa grass.
The god, facing east, places three round pindas on sacred grass and offers sesame seeds in a solemn rite to his own divine self.
Narada stands in reverence before the ascetics Nara and Narayana in their Himalayan hermitage of Badari.
